# Third-party template attribution

The root [.editorconfig](../../.editorconfig) adapts the user-supplied RehanSaeed/EditorConfig 4.0.0 reference (2021-10-12). Its MIT copyright and license notice are retained in that file. The supplied Visual Studio gitignore informs applicable ignore patterns; unsupported legacy tool-specific entries are not adopted wholesale.

The GitHub Spec Kit integration under `.specify/` and `.agents/skills/speckit-*` derives from [github/spec-kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit), version 1.1.3, source commit `0282d03eb6fc3091b3deaa3a855d4030dc40cd6c` (annotated tag object `bea765ce48b383c811872bfa2761a1e9600b7f32`). Its MIT license is preserved in [spec-kit-LICENSE.txt](spec-kit-LICENSE.txt).

Project-specific constitution, feature artifacts and identity review instructions customize this integration. This notice applies to the included third-party material and does not select a license for original project code. See [dependency evidence](../engineering/supply-chain.md) for NuGet inventory and remaining release obligations.

## OWASP ASVS catalogue

[Official ASVS 5.0.0](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/tree/5cf9b032440be53ce345ab3c130fda46ba1ce7a2) by the OWASP Foundation and ASVS contributors is licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution–ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The [English catalogue](../assurance/asvs-5.0.0.csv) is reproduced byte-for-byte unchanged; the [manifest](../assurance/catalogue.json) records its immutable source and digest. Retain this attribution and license link when redistributing it.

Local control routing, interpretive notes and assessment fields under `docs/assurance/` are project additions and are provided under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 terms where they adapt ASVS content. They are not official OWASP assessments, endorsements or certification. This attribution does not change the licensing of unrelated project code.
